events.description: Please join us for The Bookies Sunday Book Club in a relaxed, friendly environment. Held each first Sunday of the month, this is simply a space for book-lovers to gather, share their thoughts, and read good books. Everyone is welcome! December's book is Time of the Child by Niall Williams.

events.title: Memorial Birthday Celebration for Bookies Founder
events.description: Join us as we celebrate the memory of Bookies Bookstore founder, Sue Lubeck. Cake will be served. All are invited. Reservations are not required but can help us with planning.

events.title: Storytime with local author Ashley Key
events.description: Join us for a special storytime with local CO author Ashley Key. Ashley will be reading her newest children's book, Echo and the Frozen Sky . Special activity to follow. About the Author Ashley Key is a children's author, former satellite communications specialist and technical writer, and STEM educator who loves turning big science concepts into magical adventures for young readers. Inspired by her Siberian husky, Drake, her books blend lyrical storytelling with real-world science to spark curiosity in children ages 0–8. Through interactive storytimes featuring hands-on experiments, movement, and crafts, Ashley brings books to life for families, libraries, museums, and bookstores across the country. She is the author of Dash and the Lights in the Sky and the upcoming Echo and the Frozen Sky .
